aliases: cambridge b2 business vantage bec vantage
exam_format: Paper-based or computer-based; Reading, Writing, Listening, Speaking components
exam_price_notes: Price varies by country. Typically $200-$320 globally.

lifecycle.summary: Still offered by the issuer, but only in China: Cambridge English's Business qualifications page says 'The BEC suite of exams, comprising B1 Business Preliminary (BEC Preliminary), B2 Business Vantage (BEC Vantage) and C1 Business Higher (BEC Higher), will continue to be available in China but has been discontinued in all other countries. The BEC exams will now take place once a year starting from 2025. The exam dates for 2026 are as follows: May 16: BEC Business Preliminary and Higher May 23: BEC Business Vantage'. No successor is named (the FAQ points to Linguaskill and B2 First as alternatives).
